backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Theiarco backend, implementing CRUD operations for user profiles, publishers, pioneers, territories, shepherding visits, service meeting conductors, field service groups, tasks, and notes, with role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to their implementation files, components, and test IDs for PDF export utilities (pioneers, tasks, notes, publishers) and other app features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, used as a reference for build planning and code navigation.
frontend/.env: Environment configuration file setting the Internet Identity provider URL to https://identity.ic0.app for authentication.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark modes including colors for background, foreground, sidebar, charts, and UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Theiarco React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that handles authentication state and defines all TanStack Router routes for the application, including publishers, pioneers, territories, shepherding, conductors, field service groups, tasks, notes, and user profile pages.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Condu: Modal dialog component for creating and editing trained service meeting conductors, with fields for publisher selection, training date, availability by day of week, status, and notes.
frontend/src/components/conductors/Delet: Alert dialog component for confirming deletion of a trained conductor record, using the useDeleteTrainedConductor mutation hook with a loading state indicator.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Att: Display card showing attendance statistics including total publishers, average mid-week and weekend attendance with percentage progress bars.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Del: Alert dialog for confirming permanent deletion of a meeting attendance record, using the useDeleteMeetingAttendance mutation hook.
Alert dialog for confirming deletion of a group visit record, using the useDeleteGroupVisit mutation hook with toast notifications for success and error feedback.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Gro: Card component displaying a group visit's details including date, discussion topics, publishers present, and notes, with optional edit and delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/fieldService/Rec: Modal dialog for creating or editing a meeting attendance record, allowing selection of date, meeting type, and which publishers were present.
Modal dialog for creating or editing a group visit record, with fields for visit date, discussion topics, publishers present, notes, and next planned visit date.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root application layout component composing the sidebar, header, main content outlet, toast notifications, and a global reconnect toast manager.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Top navigation header displaying the app title, a mobile menu toggle button, and a logout button that clears the identity and React Query cache.
frontend/src/components/layout/Sidebar.t: Renders a responsive sidebar navigation component with themed active/hover states for each route, supporting mobile overlay and toggle behavior.
frontend/src/components/notes/AddGlobalN: Modal dialog for creating or editing a global note with fields for title, content, category, and optional publisher attachment.
frontend/src/components/notes/GlobalNote: Displays a single global note as a card with category badge, content preview, creation date, and edit/delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/AddPion: Modal dialog for submitting a pioneer's hours for a specific month and service year using a numeric input.
Modal dialog for adding a new pioneer record by selecting an active publisher and a service year.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Current: Displays a badge indicating a pioneer's tracking status (On Track, Behind, or No Entries) based on their average monthly hours for a service year.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/DeleteP: Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a pioneer record, with success and error toast notifications.
Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a specific pioneer monthly hours record, with a loading state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/EditPio: A modal dialog component for editing a pioneer's monthly hours record, with form validation and a loading state during submission.
A modal dialog for editing an existing pioneer's publisher assignment and service year, with form pre-filling and toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/pioneers/Pioneer: A card component displaying a pioneer's total hours, service year average, and current status badge (loading, no-entries, on-track, or behind).
A table row component for a single pioneer that fetches and displays their total hours, average hours, current status badge, and edit/delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/publicWitnessing: An alert dialog that confirms and executes deletion of a trained publisher record via a mutation hook.
A modal form for creating or editing a trained publisher, handling publisher selection, training date, authorization status, and S-148 receipt fields.
frontend/src/components/publishers/AddPu: A modal form for adding a new publisher with fields for name, field service group, privileges, and role checkboxes, showing toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/publishers/Delet: File content was not provided; likely a confirmation dialog for deleting a publisher note.
frontend/src/components/publishers/EditP: A modal dialog for editing an existing publisher's details including name, field service group, privileges, and active status. Initializes form state from the provided publisher prop and submits updates via the useUpdatePublisher hook.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Edit: A modal dialog for editing an existing shepherding visit, allowing updates to publisher, visit date, and elders present fields. Initializes form from the provided visit prop and submits changes via the useUpdateShepherdingVisit hook.
frontend/src/components/shepherding/Reco: A modal dialog for recording a new shepherding visit with fields for publisher, visit date, elders present, and notes. Submits the new visit via the useCreateShepherdingVisit hook and resets the form on close.
frontend/src/components/system/Reconnect: A renderless component that monitors in-flight queries, mutations, and actor availability to display a persistent 'Reconnecting…' toast when connectivity is lost and a success toast when it is restored.
frontend/src/components/tasks/AddTaskMod: A modal dialog for creating a new task with title, due date, category, and optional notes fields. Submits the task via the useCreateTask hook and resets the form on success or close.
frontend/src/components/tasks/EditTaskMo: A modal dialog for editing an existing task's title, due date, category, and notes. Initializes form state from the provided task prop and submits updates via the useUpdateTask hook.
frontend/src/components/territories/AddT: Modal dialog for creating a new territory with fields for territory number/name and type, including validation and success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/territories/Chec: Displays a sorted table of checkout history records for a territory, with edit and delete action buttons per row.
Modal dialog for checking out a territory to a publisher, with fields for publisher selection, checkout date, and campaign flag.
frontend/src/components/territories/Dele: Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a specific checkout record from a territory.
Confirmation alert dialog for permanently deleting a territory note.
frontend/src/components/territories/Edit: Modal dialog for editing an existing checkout record, pre-filling publisher, dates, and campaign flag, then submitting updates via mutation.
Modal dialog for editing an existing territory's number and type, pre-filling current values and submitting updates via mutation.
Modal dialog for editing an existing territory note, using a textarea and the useUpdateTerritoryNote hook to save changes with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/territories/Terr: Card component that displays a single territory note's content and creation date with edit and delete action buttons.
Section component for a territory's notes page that handles creating, listing, editing, and deleting notes using a textarea composer and child modal/dialog components.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedPr: A themed primary button component that accepts a themeColor prop and automatically computes a contrasting text color using getContrastColor.
frontend/src/components/theming/ThemedTa: Provides ThemedTableHeaderRow and ThemedTableHead components that apply a theme color background/text with automatic contrast calculation to table headers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddMeetingAttendan: Mutation hook that records meeting attendance by calling the backend actor with group, date, type, and publisher data, then invalidates meetingAttendance queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddPublisher.ts: Mutation hook that adds a new publisher to the backend by mapping UI privilege options to backend privilege objects and invalidating the publishers query on success.
Provides hooks for fetching (useGetCallerUserProfile) and saving (useSaveCallerUserProfile) the current authenticated user's profile via the backend actor.
Mutation hook that checks out a territory to a publisher by calling the backend actor with a normalized epoch-seconds date, then invalidates territory-related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGlobalNote.t: Mutation hook that creates a global note with title, content, category, and optional publisher attachment, invalidating globalNotes queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateGroupVisit.t: Mutation hook that submits a new group visit record to the backend and invalidates the relevant groupVisits queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreatePioneer.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new pioneer record via the backend actor and invalidates the pioneers list query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateShepherdingV: Mutation hook that creates a shepherding visit record via the backend actor and invalidates shepherdingVisits queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTask.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new task with title, due date, category, and optional notes via the backend actor, invalidating all task queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTerritory.ts: Mutation hook that creates a new territory with a generated unique ID by calling the backend actor, then invalidates the territories query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook that calls `addTrainedConductor` on the actor and invalidates the `trainedConductors` cache on success, showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook that creates a trained publisher via `addTrainedPublisher` and optionally sets S-148 status, invalidating the `trainedPublishers` cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCheckoutReco: React Query mutation hook that deletes a territory checkout record by territoryId, publisherId, and date, then invalidates the relevant territory and territories list queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGlobalNote.t: React Query mutation hook that deletes a global note by ID and invalidates the `globalNotes` query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteGroupVisit.t: React Query mutation hook that deletes a group visit by visitId and invalidates/removes related group visit cache entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteMeetingAtten: React Query mutation hook that deletes a meeting attendance record by ID, invalidates the `meetingAttendance` cache, and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePioneer.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a pioneer by ID, invalidates the `pioneers` list query, and removes the individual pioneer cache entry.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeletePublisher.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a publisher with optimistic UI updates, rolling back on error and refetching on settle, with toast error notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTask.ts: React Query mutation hook that deletes a task by bigint ID and invalidates all `tasks` queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook that deletes a trained conductor by ID, invalidates the `trainedConductors` cache, and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook that deletes a trained publisher by ID, invalidates the `trainedPublishers` cache, and shows toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useGlobalNotes.ts: Exports two React Query hooks: `useGetAllGlobalNotes` for fetching all global notes and `useGetGlobalNote` for fetching a single note by bigint ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisit.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single group visit by visitId from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGroupVisits.ts: React Query hook that fetches all group visits for a given group ID, guarding against invalid group IDs.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and identity state including status flags.
React Query hook that fetches meeting attendance records, optionally filtered by group number, from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneerHours.ts: Exports multiple React Query hooks and mutations for fetching, adding, updating, and deleting pioneer monthly hours records, with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneers.ts: Exports two React Query hooks: `useGetAllPioneers` for fetching all pioneers and `useGetPioneer` for fetching a single pioneer by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/usePioneersOnTrack.ts: React Query hook that calculates the count of pioneers averaging 50 or more hours per month for a given service year by fetching all pioneers and their monthly hours.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports two React Query hooks: `useGetAllPublishers` for fetching all publishers and `useGetPublisher` for fetching a single publisher by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceMeetingCond: React Query hook that fetches all Service Meeting Conductor assignments from the backend actor, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useShepherdingVisit.t: React Query hooks for fetching a single shepherding visit by ID, updating a visit's full data or just its notes, and deleting a visit, with cache invalidation on mutations.
React Query hook that fetches all shepherding visits from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: React Query hooks for fetching a filtered list of tasks by status and a single task by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritories.ts: React Query hook that fetches all territories from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritory.ts: React Query hooks for fetching a single territory by ID and mutations for updating, deleting, marking as returned, and making a territory available, with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useTerritoryNotes.ts: React Query hooks for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes associated with a specific territory, scoped by territoryId.
frontend/src/hooks/useTrainedConductor.t: React Query hooks for fetching a single trained conductor by ID, updating only its notes field, and deleting it, with cache invalidation.
React Query hook that fetches all trained Service Meeting Conductors from the backend actor.
React Query hook that fetches all trained publishers from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCheckoutReco: Mutation hook that updates a territory checkout record, normalizing timestamps to epoch seconds before sending to the backend and invalidating territory caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGlobalNote.t: Mutation hook that updates a global note's title, content, category, and optional attached publisher, invalidating the globalNotes cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateGroupVisit.t: Mutation hook that updates a group visit record with full field data and invalidates related group visit queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateMeetingAtten: Mutation hook that updates a meeting attendance record, converting the meeting date to epoch seconds, with toast notifications and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePioneer.ts: Mutation hook that edits a pioneer record by ID and invalidates both the pioneers list and the individual pioneer cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdatePublisher.ts: Mutation hook that updates a publisher's details, mapping UI privilege selections to backend privilege objects and invalidating the publishers list cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTask.ts: Mutation hook that updates a task by ID with new input data and invalidates all task queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTaskCompleti: Mutation hook that toggles a task's completion status by ID and invalidates all task queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedCondu: React Query mutation hook for updating a trained conductor, invalidating related queries and showing a success toast on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateTrainedPubli: React Query mutation hook for updating a trained publisher's details and S-148 status via two separate actor calls, with success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark theme colors including custom dashboard stat and Theiarco brand colors using OKLCH.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ComingSoon.tsx: Simple placeholder page component that displays a 'Coming Soon' message with a construction icon for features under development.
frontend/src/pages/ConductorProfile.tsx: Detail page for a trained conductor showing their info, editable notes, and options to edit or delete the conductor with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page that aggregates and displays congregation stats including active publishers, checked-out territories, uncompleted tasks, pioneers on track, meeting attendance, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroupProf: Detail page for a specific field service group showing its publishers, group visits, meeting attendance records, and attendance statistics with modals for recording and editing entries.
frontend/src/pages/FieldServiceGroups.ts: Page listing all four field service groups as clickable cards, each showing the group's overseer, assistant, and active publishers.
frontend/src/pages/GroupVisitProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile page for a single group visit, showing attendees, discussion topics, and notes, with options to edit or delete the visit and navigate back to the group profile.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Renders the login page for the Theiarco app, providing an Internet Identity authentication button with loading state feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx: Displays a filterable list of global notes by category with options to add, edit, delete, and export notes to PDF, using themed UI components.
frontend/src/pages/PioneerProfile.tsx: Shows a detailed profile for an individual pioneer including monthly hours tracking with inline editing, summary stats, and options to add, edit, or delete hours records and the pioneer itself.
frontend/src/pages/Pioneers.tsx: Lists all pioneers in a table with options to add, edit, delete, navigate to individual profiles, and export data to CSV or PDF formats.
frontend/src/pages/PublicWitnessing.tsx: Displays a sorted table of trained public witnessing publishers with authorization status and S-148 form info, supporting add, edit, and delete actions via modals.
frontend/src/pages/PublisherProfile.tsx: Displays a detailed profile page for a single publisher, showing their attributes and badges, with options to edit or delete the publisher via a modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Publishers.tsx: Renders a filterable, sortable table of all publishers with search, group, and active-status filters, plus add/edit/delete actions via modals and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ServiceMeetingConduct: Displays a sorted table of trained service meeting conductors with add, edit, and delete capabilities, using themed table headers and navigation to individual conductor profiles.
frontend/src/pages/Shepherding.tsx: Shows a searchable, date-sorted list of shepherding visits with options to record new visits, edit existing ones, and delete them via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/ShepherdingVisitProfi: Displays the detail view for a single shepherding visit, allowing inline editing of notes with save/cancel, plus edit and delete actions via modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/Tasks.tsx: Tasks page component that displays a filterable, sortable table of tasks with add, edit, delete, and export (CSV/PDF) functionality using themed UI components.
frontend/src/pages/Territories.tsx: Territories page component that lists all territories in a sortable table with add, edit, delete, and CSV export actions, including checkout duration display.
frontend/src/pages/TerritoryProfile.tsx: Detail page for a single territory showing its status, checkout history, and notes, with modals for editing, checking out, and deleting the territory or its checkout records.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfile.tsx: User profile page allowing inline editing of the user's full name and congregation name, with save/cancel controls and toast notifications.
frontend/src/theme/colorUtils.ts: Utility functions for color manipulation including hex-to-RGB parsing, WCAG luminance calculation, contrast color selection (black/white), and color lightening.
frontend/src/theme/pageTheme.ts: Defines a centralized mapping of page route paths to theme hex colors and provides helper functions to look up the theme color for a given path.
frontend/src/utils/fieldServiceGroupColo: Defines a color mapping for field service groups 1–4 and exports a helper function to retrieve a group's color by number.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Collection of date-formatting utilities that convert backend bigint timestamps (in nanoseconds or seconds) to human-readable 'MMM d, yyyy' strings for notes, tasks, checkouts, visits, weeks, and training dates.
frontend/src/utils/groupVisitNotes.ts: Parses a combined notes string (created by RecordGroupVisitModal) into structured fields: discussionTopics, overseerNotes, assistantNotes, and nextPlannedVisitDate using regex section matching.
frontend/src/utils/meetingAttendanceStat: Provides utility functions to calculate meeting attendance statistics including active publisher counts, average attendance by meeting type, percentages, and an overview across all groups.
frontend/src/utils/notesPdfExport.ts: Exports GlobalNote records to a styled PDF via the browser print API, grouping notes by category with color-coded headings and sorting newest first within each category.
frontend/src/utils/pioneersCsvExport.ts: Builds and downloads a CSV export of pioneer service data, including monthly hours across the service year (September–August), totals, averages, and current status.
frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts: Exports pioneer service data to a styled landscape PDF via the browser print API, rendering a table with monthly hours, totals, averages, and color-coded status per pioneer.
frontend/src/utils/privilegeBadges.ts: Returns Tailwind CSS class strings for privilege badge styling, mapping 'Elder' to purple and 'Ministerial Servant' to blue.
frontend/src/utils/reconnectState.ts: Implements a singleton observable state class that tracks whether an 'Actor not available' error is active and notifies subscribed listeners on changes.
frontend/src/utils/serviceYear.ts: Calculates and returns the current service year as a 'YYYY-YYYY' string, where the year runs from September through August.
frontend/src/utils/tasksCsvExport.ts: Builds and triggers a browser download of a CSV file containing task data (title, due date, category, status, notes) from an array of Task objects.
frontend/src/utils/tasksPdfExport.ts: Exports an array of Task objects to a styled portrait PDF via the browser print API, rendering a table with title, due date, category, status, and notes.
frontend/src/utils/territoryAssignmentRe: Builds and downloads a CSV file in S-13-E Territory Assignment Record format, including territory number, last completion date, and the 4 most recent checkout records per territory.
frontend/src/utils/territoryTime.ts: Provides utility functions for normalizing backend timestamps (handling nanoseconds, milliseconds, and seconds) and calculating human-readable checkout durations in days or months.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers for maintaining values like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (primary, secondary, sidebar, chart, etc.), custom border radii, accordion keyframe animations, and typography/container-queries/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for the Theiarco app, documenting completed features (PDF export utilities for Pioneers, Tasks, and Notes pages) and new feature requests with branding requirements using the #43587A primary color.
